purpose: Golden set for Evaluate-node precision/recall. 20 candidate items labelled feature/discard, split across both content mixes (owned + external) and both PRD archetypes (producer + startup).
labeller_note: Labels reflect a competent marketer's judgement for the given company profile — 'feature' items are ones we would want to see in the newsletter this week; 'discard' items are ones the human would refuse.

positioning.value_prop: Route your warehouse without a forklift retrofit.

items.title: Harvest is starting — first Riesling grapes are in
items.angle: Behind-the-scenes photos from day one of picking. Hand-carried baskets, family involvement.
items.expected_hint: Own the moment: seasonal, on-brand, hand-picked shows differentiator.

items.title: Meet the 5th-generation family behind the estate
items.angle: Portrait interview with the father-daughter team.
items.expected_hint: Family story is an explicit voice.do and a differentiator.

items.title: Introducing the 2023 Riesling — order now
items.angle: Hard sell on the vintage: hype, urgency, buy links.
items.expected_hint: Voice.dont says no hype. Purely promotional.

items.title: German wine exports up 3% year-on-year — Wine Trade Monthly
items.angle: What the export tick means for a small Rheinhessen estate: not much, but nice to know.
items.expected_hint: Adjacent industry, but a small DTC producer's audience doesn't care.

items.title: Crypto winter deepens as Coinbase reports losses
items.angle: Coinbase.
items.expected_hint: Zero relevance.

items.title: Autumn tastings — book your Saturday in October
items.angle: Event promotion for the tastings pillar.
items.expected_hint: Events pillar exists; seasonal timing.

items.title: How steep-slope viticulture is disappearing across Europe
items.angle: Article on the decline of steep-slope viticulture — the estate is one of the few holdouts.
items.expected_hint: Directly reinforces a differentiator and gives them a story to tell.

items.title: 10% off with code HARVEST — limited time
items.angle: Discount promo.
items.expected_hint: Voice is unpretentious, not promotional. Discount codes are off-brand.

items.title: Rheinhessen wines find new fans in Berlin's natural-wine scene
items.angle: Regional shoutout — the estate could ride this trend.
items.expected_hint: Geo-relevant, ICP-relevant, on-brand tone.

items.title: Cellar temperature dropped 2°C overnight — a quick word on why
items.angle: Craft explainer — how temperature discipline shapes vintage character.
items.expected_hint: Craft + terroir + educational; hits the pillar and voice.

items.title: DHL warehouse pilot cuts pick times 30%
items.angle: Article on DHL's warehouse robotics pilot — what it means for mid-size 3PLs that can't afford the same capex.
items.expected_hint: Numbers, ICP, industry pillar, direct positioning connect.

items.title: Amazon opens 4 new fulfilment centres in Poland
items.angle: How does Poland fit into DACH 3PL positioning? Poland pressure on cross-border 3PLs.
items.expected_hint: Geo overlap (EU/DACH), competitive angle.

items.title: 3 questions we get from every 50-person 3PL — and how we answer them
items.angle: Proof pillar: real conversations, real answers, minimal AI-buzz.
items.expected_hint: ICP-specific, proof pillar, no-hype voice.

items.title: AI is going to change everything about logistics — thought piece
items.angle: AI will transform logistics.
items.expected_hint: Voice.dont: 'AI-will-change-everything takes' is called out explicitly.

items.title: New AWS EC2 instance types announced
items.angle: AWS news.
items.expected_hint: Not warehouse ops. Off-topic.

items.title: Our founder's routine for onboarding a 3PL in 2 weeks
items.angle: Behind-the-scenes on the integration promise (differentiator).
items.expected_hint: Ties directly to differentiator '2-week integration'.

items.title: Pick rate benchmarks across mid-size warehouses — new industry report
items.angle: Concrete numbers on pick rate — perfect for a business whose vocabulary includes 'pick rate'.
items.expected_hint: Directly on vocabulary and ICP; show numbers.

items.title: Our exciting new AI-powered warehouse platform of the future
items.angle: Hype-laden marketing copy.
items.expected_hint: Voice.dont: buzzwords + 'AI-will-change-everything'. This is exactly what to reject.

items.title: Post-Brexit customs headaches force UK 3PLs to rethink EU strategy
items.angle: How EU-only 3PL setups (DACH ICP) can win from UK 3PL pain.
items.expected_hint: Adjacent, geo-relevant, but requires a strong angle to justify featuring.

items.title: Customer story: A 200-person 3PL went from 60% to 82% pick accuracy in 6 weeks
items.angle: Direct customer result. Numbers-first. Voice-matched.
items.expected_hint: Numbers, ICP, differentiator (integration speed), proof pillar.
